records.section_heading: SATELLITE TELEMETRY OF GREEN TURTLES NESTING AT FRENCH FRIGATE SHOALS, HAWAII, AND ROSE ATOLL, AMERICAN SAMOA
records.question: In what year was satellite telemetry of sea turtles in Hawaii initiated according to the section?
ground_truth_chunks: Satellite telemetry of sea turtles in Hawaii was initiated in 1992 and resulted in the first known successful high-seas tracking of a green turtle migrating from a nesting site to a resident foraging pasture (Balazs 1994).

records.question: What duty cycle were the ST-3 transmitters programmed with?
records.ground_truth_answer: The transmitters were programmed with a duty cycle of 6 hours on, 6 hours off.
